summary: Completed end-to-end verification of R1-05 and R1-06 P0 bug fixes in fresh environment. Both backend and frontend tests passed successfully.
passed_tests: R1-06 Backend: Over-return blocked (qty=9999 > available 24) - Returns HTTP 400 with 'Retur melebihi batas' message
R1-06 Backend: Within-limit allowed (qty=10, cumulative=16 <= 30) - Returns HTTP 200, creates return successfully
R1-06 Backend: Cumulative overflow blocked (16+20=36 > 30) - Returns HTTP 400, enforces cumulative cap
R1-05 Backend: Transparency fields present - GET /api/purchase-requisitions/reorder-suggestions returns on_request and existing_prs fields for all items
R1-05 Backend: Projection reduces with PR creation - Creating PR for prod_benang_katun (qty=100) correctly updates on_request=100 and existing_prs array
R1-05 Backend: Anti-duplicate removal - After creating second PR (qty=200, total=300), prod_benang_katun removed from suggestions (300 > rop 250)
R1-05 Frontend: Reorder UI accessible - Successfully navigated to Saran Reorder view via PEMBELIAN menu
R1-05 Frontend: On-Request column present - Column header 'ON-REQUEST' visible in table
R1-05 Frontend: on_request values displayed - All product rows show on_request values with correct testid pattern
R1-05 Frontend: Anti-duplicate verification - prod_benang_katun correctly absent from suggestions (fully covered by open PRs)

r1_06_sales_return_validation.description: Sales return over-return validation working correctly. Cumulative quantity cap enforced at both creation and approval stages.
test_scenarios: Over-return attempt (9999 > 24 available) correctly blocked with HTTP 400
Valid return within limits (qty=10) successfully created
implementation_verified: Error messages include 'Retur melebihi batas' and 'maksimum' as specified
Defense-in-depth: validation at both create and approve stages

r1_05_reorder_anti_duplicate.description: Reorder suggestions anti-duplicate PR logic working correctly. Items with open PRs are tracked and removed when fully covered.
test_scenarios: Transparency fields (on_request, existing_prs) present in all reorder suggestion items
Creating PR updates on_request and populates existing_prs array
Product removed from suggestions when projected (available + on_order + on_request) > reorder_point
implementation_verified: on_request calculated from open PRs (draft, pending_approval, approved statuses)
existing_prs array contains PR numbers for badge display
projected = available + on_order + on_request includes PR quantities
Items excluded when projected > reorder_point (anti-duplicate logic)
ui_verified: On-Request column header visible in table
on_request values displayed with correct testid pattern (reorder-onrequest-{product_id})
PR badges shown with testid pattern (reorder-pr-badge-{product_id}) when existing_prs present
Explanation text correctly describes projection formula including on_request
